summary: Two operator-reported items cut. Cut A (commit 4f1dd7f) — LoginPage rewritten from a magic-link flow to a two-step in-app email-then-6-digit-code flow. signInWithOtp sends the code; verifyOtp({type:'email'}) verifies it inside the PWA, so the auth session lands in the PWA's own storage scope and persists across launches. Root cause of 'magic-link login not remembered, redo every time': on iOS a magic link opens in Safari, a separate storage scope from the installed PWA, so the PWA never sees the session. The code screen has resend and use-different-email; /auth/callback is kept as a fallback for anyone who clicks the link. Cut B (commit e52603e) — the bare single-field DisplayNamePrompt replaced by a four-screen guided IdentityCeremony: welcome (the keypair is born, the responsibility is real), name (display name required, full name optional), declaration (read and affirm a founding statement via checkbox), signing. createIdentityAttestation now takes an IdentityInput object and signs display_name, full_name, declaration, pubkey, created_at as leaves; the identity attestation tier was raised routine to notable because the founding identity is the root of the whole chain.

why.text: Operator: 'Not remembering magic link login it's making you redo every time. Name attestation needs to be more formal and walk you down the birth of your identity the responsibility and make it special guided moment with proper fields.' Two distinct cuts. Cut A is a real bug with a real root cause — the iOS PWA storage-scope split — fixed by keeping the entire login inside the PWA context via a typed code rather than a clicked link. Cut B is a deliberate ceremony: the operator wanted the moment of identity creation to convey weight and responsibility, not be a throwaway form field. The founding declaration is signed as a leaf on the identity attestation, so the person did not just tap through — they signed a statement. Both verified: all four gates green at 19/19 after each cut.

Operator-side follow-up required for Cut A: the Supabase 'Magic Link' email template must include the {{ .Token }} variable or the email will not carry the 6-digit code. [FEEDBACK->Foreman]: no notes — the two operator directives were concrete and the root cause of the login bug was unambiguous once traced to the iOS storage-scope split.

Until the operator walks the real flow on a phone, the fix is correct-by-construction but not confirmed-in-the-field.
